name: Lavi
source:
"Such an annoying insect. Wouldn't it be better if it is crushed."

One of the Brides. She is partnered with the teacher [url=/c135514]Luciela[/url].

Laying waste to her surroundings, manipulating the "Gravity" at her disposal. Wielding a huge hammer that exceeds her height, she is not afraid of anything.

Like a doll, she looks pretty and quiet, but she is actually rather sharp-tongued, not opening up to others, and does not want to interact with them.

However, she is very fond of her bearer Luciela, without hesitation, she would do anything for her.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.ensemble-game.com/30.kyokumari/character_08_lavi.html]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]Her true name is Flavia.[/spoiler]
